title: 第19章 可爱的狐狸第20章 准备工作
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可慢悠悠地回到洞穴，迎接她的是那只依旧躺在窝里懒洋洋、动也不动的狐狸。
“我离开后她居然就没从那地方挪过窝。”艾可无语地盯着她，喃喃自语道。“好吧，我有点困了，咱也休息吧……”
村子里发生的事以及那些纷繁复杂的信息把她累得够呛，此刻最好的进阶方法无疑就是休息，让脑子清醒清醒，等到明天才能好好思考一番。
……
女王悠悠转醒。“又一天独自一人……”她长长地叹着气，试图站起身来，却感觉身体愈发沉重。“我没长胖吧？”她紧皱着眉头，心里暗自嘀咕，可不能因为那熊肉比自己想象的稍微好吃那么一点儿就把身材给搞砸了。
她低头看向自己的身体，却意外地发现了一个小得有些不正常的毛茸茸的东西。“……这窝不够大吗……？”她紧紧地盯着那个正缓慢呼吸着、似乎还沉浸在睡梦中的毛球。“你就不能睡别的地方去？！我真的饿了！”她的脸皱成了一团，然而既没有咆哮，也没有动弹。“再五分钟应该也没什么……”
……五个小时后……
“……”女王一脸无语地盯着刚刚醒来的小毛球。
艾可一看到狐狸，瞬间就僵在了原地。她并非是感到寒冷，而是在睡过巴迪的沙发之后，这窝就显得不那么舒服了，于是她就想着这狐狸是不是会更柔软暖和一些。结果简直是太软了，艾可一下子就睡着了！
她尴尬地从狐狸身上下来，耳朵低垂着，尾巴却欢快地摇个不停。显然，对于昨晚的休息，她感到十分满意。
“至少决定好是内疚还是高兴！别两个都占！”女王大声斥责她，但看到她那垂头丧气的表情，又实在生不起气来。
她轻轻哼了一声，暗自生自己的气，怎么就中了这毛球的圈套。从现在起，她一定要坚定决心，绝不轻易退让！
……一炷香的时间……
“有那么好吃吗？”女王看着这毛球狼吞虎咽的样子，仿佛命都系在这食物上，不禁问道。
“你还用问？！”艾可回瞪着她，与此同时……
[经验值增加。][经验值增加。][经验值增加。][经验值增加。]
“这东西太棒了！”艾可大声称赞道。
女王撅起嘴，心里很不高兴这小野兽居然没见识过上界的美味，居然能对这普通的肉如此享受。“慢点吃，还有呢。”女王向艾可保证道，但心里却忍不住咒骂起来，因为她突然意识到了一件重要的事情。
“这是今天最后一块肉了。”她表情严肃地说道，这可把艾可吓了一跳。“我可不能让她的兽核被污染太多。”她却不知道，其实已经太晚了……
艾可的表情瞬间变得像是丢了魂一样，女王也被吓了一跳。“好吧，你可以吃这一小块，但不能再多了！”她立刻就妥协了。

……
“听好了！就因为你比别的家伙稍微聪明点，可不代表你有多特别！你得学会基本的技法，在灵气不足的时候也能应付自如！”女王耐心地解释着，同时十分享受这只聪明得不可思议的野兽认真听她说话、专注地关注着她的模样。她也喜欢这小野兽什么都不懂、把所有情绪都毫无保留地表露出来的样子。
“你首先要学的是[轻身术]。跟我来。”女王几乎是瞬间就跑开了，不过艾可费了好大的劲才勉强跟上。
“这是正常的跑步速度，但是如果你使用[轻身术]。”女王迅速运转体内的能量，一丝一毫都没有外泄，速度瞬间翻倍还多，这可把艾可吓了一跳。
艾可立刻使用了[冲刺]，因为[暗影行走]只是用来跟上她正常的速度。
“不错。”女王称赞道。“但你太耗费体力了。”她能够清楚地看出艾可的肌肉每过一秒就更加疲惫一分。
“我能跑更远，因为我只是运转灵气，而你得耗费大量的体力才能跟上我！”她斥责艾可，因为看到她已经气喘吁吁的样子。
“就到这儿吧。”女王在一片美丽的草地上停了下来。“你要学习[冥想]，这样能够补充你消耗的体力。这也能让你恢复消耗的灵气。这是个非常重要的技能，你得尽快掌握，因为修炼的关键就是开悟和冥想！”她详细地解释道。
艾可终于能够喘口气了，感觉自己就快要死了，因为她一心想要跟这狐狸比一比，把自己逼得实在是太狠了。这真是个糟糕的主意，这女王可比艾可强大太多了。
“等你学会[冥想]，我就给你几块肉。”女王已经清楚地知道该怎么哄这小野兽乖乖听话了。她以前经常这样做来哄她的小玩具。她经常给他梳头或者抱抱他，让他开心快乐。
*叹气*
“啥都没了，只剩回忆。这野兽可跟那混蛋不一样，会好好伺候我的！”她在心里暗自笑着。
“首先你得让自己舒服一点。”女王下达命令，然后静静地等待着。没过多久，艾可就没精打采地瘫倒在地上，活像一块动物地毯。女王强忍着不让自己笑出声来，因为这野兽唯一还活着的迹象就是呼气时舌头伸出来，吸气时舌头缩回去。
“现在放松你的脑子。”女王下达命令，却没有意识到自己的语气是多么的温柔。
content_en:
Ai Ke slowly returned to the cave, and what greeted her was the fox still lying lazily and motionless in the nest.
"She never moved from that place after I left." Ai Ke stared at her speechlessly and muttered to himself. "Okay, I'm a little sleepy, let's take a rest..."
What happened in the village and the complicated information made her exhausted. The best way to improve at the moment was undoubtedly to rest, clear her mind, and wait until tomorrow to think carefully.
…
The queen woke up leisurely. "Another day alone..." She sighed deeply and tried to stand up, but she felt her body getting heavier. "I haven't gained weight, have I?" She frowned and muttered to herself, but she couldn't ruin her figure just because the bear meat was slightly more delicious than she thought.
She looked down at her body and unexpectedly discovered an abnormally small, furry thing. "...Isn't this nest big enough...?" She stared closely at the fur ball that was breathing slowly and seemed to be still immersed in sleep. "Can't you sleep somewhere else?! I'm really hungry!" Her face wrinkled up, but she neither growled nor moved. "Five minutes should be fine..."
…Five hours later…
"..." The queen stared at the little fur ball that had just woken up, speechless.
As soon as Aike saw the fox, he froze in place. It wasn't that she felt cold, but after sleeping on Buddy's sofa, the nest seemed less comfortable, so she wondered if the fox would be softer and warmer. It turned out to be so soft that Aike fell asleep immediately!
She got off the fox awkwardly, her ears drooped, but her tail waggled happily. She was obviously very satisfied with her rest last night.
"At least decide whether you feel guilty or happy! Don't do both!" The Queen scolded her loudly, but seeing her dejected expression, she really couldn't get angry.
She snorted softly, secretly angry with herself for falling into the trap of this fur ball. From now on, she must be determined and never give in easily!
...the time of one stick of incense...
"Is it that delicious?" The queen couldn't help but ask as she watched the furball devouring the food, as if her life depended on it.
"You still have to ask?!" Aike stared back at her, at the same time...
[Experience points increase. ][Experience value increased. ][Experience value increased. ][Experience value increased. ]
"This thing is great!" Aiko praised loudly.
The queen pouted, feeling very unhappy that this little beast could enjoy this ordinary meat so much without having seen the delicacies of the upper world. "Eat slowly, there is still more." The Queen assured Aike, but she couldn't help cursing in her heart because she suddenly realized something important.
"This is the last piece of meat today." She said seriously, which shocked Echo. "I can't let her animal core be polluted too much." But she didn't know that it was actually too late...
Ai Ke's expression instantly changed as if she had lost her soul, and the Queen was also startled. "Okay, you can eat this small piece, but no more!" She compromised immediately.
…
"Listen up! Just because you are a little smarter than other guys, it doesn't mean you are special! You have to learn the basic techniques and be able to cope with it when your spiritual energy is insufficient!" The queen explained patiently, while enjoying the way this incredibly smart beast listened to her attentively and paid attention to her. She also liked the way this little beast understood nothing and showed all his emotions without reservation.
"The first thing you have to learn is [Light Body Technique]. Follow me." The Queen ran away almost instantly, but it took a lot of effort for Aiko to keep up.
"This is a normal running speed, butIf you use [Light Body Technique]. "The queen quickly circulated the energy in her body without any leakage, and her speed more than doubled in an instant, which shocked Ai Ke.
Echo immediately used [Sprint], as [Shadow Walk] was only used to keep up with her normal speed.
"Not bad. "The Queen praised. "But you consume too much energy. "She could clearly see that Echo's muscles were getting more tired with every passing second.
“I can run farther because I’m just running my aura, and you have to expend a lot of energy to keep up with me! ” she scolded Echo, seeing how out of breath she was.
“Just stop here. "The queen stopped on a beautiful meadow. "You have to learn [meditation], so that you can replenish the energy you have consumed. This also allows you to restore spent aura. This is a very important skill that you must master as soon as possible, because the key to practice is enlightenment and meditation! ” she explained in detail.
Aike was finally able to take a breath, feeling like she was going to die because she wanted to compete with this fox and pushed herself too hard. This is a really bad idea, this queen is much more powerful than Aike.
“When you learn [meditation], I will give you some pieces of meat. "The Queen knew exactly how to coax the little beast into obedience. She had often done this to soothe her little toy. She would often comb his hair or give him a hug to keep him happy.
*sigh*
“There’s nothing left, only memories. This beast is different from that bastard. He will take good care of me! "She smiled secretly in her heart.
“First you have to make yourself comfortable. "The queen gave the order, and then waited quietly. Not long after, Aike collapsed on the ground listlessly, like an animal carpet. The queen tried not to laugh out loud, because the only sign that the beast was alive was that its tongue stuck out when it exhaled, and retracted when it inhaled.
"Now relax your mind. "The queen gave the order, but she didn't realize how gentle her tone was.
